counts_per_charge.doc: detected counts per unit of beam charge (needs q and the efficiency)

arbitrary.doc: arbitrary units: the normalization is free (no prior) or profiled

E_UNTERMINATED_QUOTE.meaning: a quoted token has no closing quote on its line

E_QUOTE_IN_TOKEN.meaning: a quote inside a token, or text right after a closing quote

E_UNKNOWN_KIND.meaning: a line that should start a record names no record kind of its section

E_HEADER_NAME.meaning: a header without a name, or with more than '<kind> <name>' on its line

E_KEY_SYNTAX.meaning: a field key that is not a letter followed by letters, digits and '_'

E_WRONG_SECTION.meaning: a record in a section that does not hold its kind

E_DUPLICATE_NAME.meaning: a name used by two records (one namespace, F3)

E_UNKNOWN_FIELD.meaning: a key that is no field of the record's kind (fix: the nearest key)

E_FIELD_TWICE.meaning: a field that is not repeatable, given twice

E_FIELD_REQUIRED.meaning: a required or conditionally required field is missing (fix: the field with '?')

E_FIELD_NOT_APPLICABLE.meaning: a field that does not apply to the record's kind, quantity or other fields

E_FIELD_DELETED.meaning: a field an earlier format 3 had and this one does not (fix: remove it, as the message says)

E_PLACEHOLDER.meaning: a value that is '?': a value is needed (F18)

E_TOO_FEW_TOKENS.meaning: the value stops before its grammar is complete

E_NOT_A_NUMBER.meaning: a token that must be a number

E_NOT_AN_INTEGER.meaning: a token that must be an integer

E_OUT_OF_RANGE.meaning: a number or integer outside its allowed range

E_EMPTY_RANGE.meaning: a range or window whose low end is above its high end

E_NOT_IN_LIST.meaning: a word that is not one of the closed list allowed here

E_UNKNOWN_UNIT.meaning: a token that is no unit (fix: the unit whose spelling differs only in case)

E_UNIT_MISSING.meaning: a dimensioned value without its unit (there is no default unit)

E_UNIT_NOT_ALLOWED.meaning: a unit of another dimension, or one the quantity does not allow

E_NUISANCE_MODE.meaning: a nuisance without its mode fixed or fit

E_MODE_NOT_ALLOWED.meaning: a nuisance mode or prior the quantity or field does not allow

E_PRIOR_SYNTAX.meaning: a prior that is not 'prior <centre> <width>[%]' with a width > 0

E_PRIOR_CENTRE.meaning: a fitted norm whose prior is centred at 0 or below (its width is relative to the centre)

E_PART_MISSING.meaning: a structured value without one of its required keywords

E_PART_TWICE.meaning: a keyword given twice in a structured value

E_FORMULA_SYNTAX.meaning: a formula that is not quoted, or a parameter that is not <name>=<number>

E_SPIN_SYNTAX.meaning: a spin that is not 0, 1, 3/2, ... (with + or - where a parity is needed)

E_NUCLEUS_SYNTAX.meaning: a nuclide that is not <A><Symbol>, or with A < Z

E_UNKNOWN_ELEMENT.meaning: an element symbol that is not in the table (physics/Elements.h)

E_PAIR_SYNTAX.meaning: a particle pair that is not <particle>+<nucleus>[<E_x>]

E_REACTION_SYNTAX.meaning: a reaction expression that does not follow section 3.5

E_REACTION_ORDINAL.meaning: an ordinal particle label (a1, p2): name the state by its excitation energy (F4)

E_REACTION_BALANCE.meaning: a reaction that does not conserve Z and A

E_REACTION_NOT_ALLOWED.meaning: a reaction (or pair) the quantity is not defined for

E_UNKNOWN_ROLE.meaning: a column role that is not in the role table

E_ROLE_UNIT.meaning: an energy or angle role without its unit in brackets, or a unit on a role without one

E_ROLE_REQUIRED.meaning: a column the quantity requires is missing

E_ROLE_NOT_ALLOWED.meaning: a column role the quantity does not take

E_UNKNOWN_REFERENCE.meaning: a name that no record has (fix: the nearest name of the right kind)

E_REFERENCE_KIND.meaning: a name of a record of another kind than the field needs

E_UNKNOWN_EPOCH.meaning: target@epoch where the target has no such epoch

E_TARGET_KIND.meaning: a target whose kind the quantity does not take

E_DEGENERATE_NUISANCE.meaning: efficiency and norm both free without a prior (F9)

E_UNKNOWN_LEVEL.meaning: a datum's level ID that no active level of <levels> has, or two levels of its J^pi have

E_LEVEL_JPI.meaning: a datum's J^pi that is not the J^pi of the level with its ID (F13)

E_UNKNOWN_PAIR.meaning: a reaction or pair that no pair of <levels> has (particles and states)

E_AMBIGUOUS_PAIR.meaning: a reaction or pair that two pairs of <levels> have (a data set or a potential says which with a pair key)

E_NOT_A_CHANNEL.meaning: a datum's pair (or pair, l, s) that is no channel of its level, or no s-wave channel spin of the pair; a gamma_decay's final state that is no photon channel of its level

E_GAMMA_MIXTURE.meaning: a gamma_decay level that also has a non-zero photon width in <levels> (write 0 there or delete the record)

E_BRANCHING_SUM.meaning: gamma_decay branchings that are all fixed and do not sum to 1, or a fitted one without a remainder

E_BRANCHING_REMAINDER.meaning: gamma_decay branchings whose sum exceeds 1, leaving a negative remainder

E_MIXING_ONE_MULTIPOLE.meaning: a gamma_decay mixing ratio for a final state with one multipolarity in the level's channels

E_GAMMA_RECORD.meaning: a gamma_decay record that names a level twice, a final state twice, a level without photon channels, or a malformed remainder prior

E_PAIR_KEY.meaning: entrance_pair / exit_pair / pair_key where the label names one pair, or a key the label does not name

E_DATA_FILE.meaning: a data file that cannot be read, holds no data row, or has a row with fewer columns than its roles

E_DATA_ROW.meaning: a row of a data file that does not parse (four numbers), or an angular-coefficient row without a Legendre order 0-20

W_DATA_ERROR.meaning: a row inside a data set's window with an uncertainty <= 0 and no covariance file: the chi^2 skips a 0 and squares a negative one

E_COVARIANCE_FILE.meaning: a covariance file that cannot be read, does not list the data set's file with its row count, or has a variance <= 0 on a row in the window

E_FINAL_STATE_NOT_LEVEL.meaning: the final state of a photon pair with external capture that a data set or extrapolation exits into is not one level of <levels> (none, or several within 1 keV)

E_FINAL_STATE_SHARED.meaning: two photon pairs with external capture whose final states are the same level

E_NOT_BUILT.meaning: a value the table takes and this engine cannot yet set up (a unit, frame or form of a later step)

E_THM_RELATIVISTIC.meaning: a THM data set or extrapolation in a project with relativistic kinematics

E_THM_COVARIANCE.meaning: a covariance file on a THM data set (its chi^2 is its experiment's profiled one)

E_THM_EXPERIMENT_UNKNOWN.meaning: a thm field naming an experiment that <thm> has no experiment[<name>] line for

E_THM_OLD_LIST.meaning: an old member or weight list in <thm> (segments=, weight[<k>]=, weightTest[<k>]=): in format 3 the data set's thm and thm_weight fields say it

E_FOLD_CONFLICT.meaning: data sets sharing a target with a free parameter differ in beam, detector or quadrature

E_LAYER_STOPPING.meaning: a yield on a layer whose stopping is not positive and finite at an energy of its sub-point grid (set-up)

E_LAYER_EXIT_BELOW_MODEL.meaning: a yield on a layer the beam does not leave above the lowest energy the model is evaluated at (set-up)

E_STOPPING_PROJECTILE.meaning: a target whose stopping depends on the projectile (evaluation, table, scale) crossed by a neutral particle, an ion above Z = 92, or several projectiles in one data set

E_STOPPING_ACTIVE.meaning: a stopping evaluation or table whose composition does not contain the active nucleus's element

E_STOPPING_SCALE_CONFLICT.meaning: two targets that share a stopping scale (one material and projectile) and write it differently

E_STOPPING_DATA.meaning: a stopping evaluation in an engine built without SRIM's data files where neither --srim-data-dir=DIR nor the switch AZURE2_SRIM_DATA_DIR names a directory with them, or a stopping table that cannot be read (set-up)

E_REFERENCE_TABLE.meaning: the reference table of a ratio_to_reference record: unreadable, not increasing in energy, a value <= 0, or not covering an energy of the data set or grid (build)

E_STOPPING_RANGE.meaning: a target's stopping asked for at an energy outside its range: SRIM's above 1e7 keV/u, or a table's ends (set-up)

E_LAB_JACOBIAN_AT_LIMIT.meaning: a laboratory-frame differential datum at the kinematic maximum lab angle, where dOmega_lab/dOmega_cm is 0 and the lab-frame model diverges (set-up)

E_POTENTIAL_TWICE.meaning: two potential records for one pair

E_POTENTIAL_PAIR_KIND.meaning: a potential record on a photon or beta pair (a potential belongs to a particle pair)

E_POTENTIAL_RELATIVISTIC.meaning: a potential record in a project with relativistic kinematics

E_THM_HYBRID_POTENTIAL.meaning: a THM data set or extrapolation whose entrance pair has a potential record

E_OLD_POTENTIAL_BLOCK.meaning: the old <potential> block in a format-3 project (AZURE2 --convert writes potential records)

E_CONFIG_KEY_REMOVED.meaning: a <config> key that format 3 no longer has (useAdaptiveGrid: every fold is on the shared mesh)

E_CONFIG_OPTION_VALUE.meaning: an option of the calculation in <config> (use_brune, transform, ...) with a value other than 0, 1, true or false

E_CONFIG_OPTIONS_CONTRADICT.meaning: two options of the calculation that cannot hold together, whatever gave them: a flag, a keyword, a <config> key or the default (use_park=1 with use_brune=0, use_rmc=1 with use_brune=1, ec_convection_current=0 with use_long_wavelength=1)

E_PARAMETER_FILE_NO_MATCH.meaning: a parameter file (param.sav as a run's start) none of whose names is a parameter of the run

W_PARAMETER_FILE_NAMES.meaning: a parameter file with names the project has no parameter for, or without names of parameters it has

W_PARAMETER_SETTING_UNKNOWN.meaning: a <parameterSettings> row that names no parameter of the project (ignored)

E_SO_TWO_SPINS.meaning: a spin-orbit term on a pair whose two particles both have spin (the coupled treatment is not implemented)

E_SO_ZERO_SPIN.meaning: a spin-orbit term acting on a particle of spin 0 (it would vanish)

E_SO_RELATIVISTIC.meaning: a spin-orbit term in a project with relativistic kinematics

E_SO_THM.meaning: a THM data set or extrapolation whose entrance pair's potential has a spin-orbit term

E_SO_NEEDS_J.meaning: channel functions of a pair with a spin-orbit term asked for without J (pyazr, the API)

E_SO_NO_TERM.meaning: channel functions of a pair without a spin-orbit term asked for with a J (pyazr, the API)

W_NOT_MEASURABLE.meaning: a data set of a quantity that is computed for tests and comparison, not measured

W_BROAD_LEVEL.meaning: a resonance strength of a level with Gamma / E_r > 1 %: eq. (8) and the area of the resonance differ

W_NEARBY_LEVEL.meaning: a resonance strength of a level with another level of its J^pi within 10 Gamma

W_DATA_FILE_NOT_READ.meaning: a data file that cannot be read in a run that does not use the data (an extrapolation): not read
